newsitem.title: UK: OFTEL confirms ban on BT reconnection offer.
newsitem.headline: OFTEL confirms ban on BT reconnection offer.

text.p: Britain's telecommunications industry watchdog OFTEL said on Tuesday it had confirmed its ban on British Telecommunications Plc's re-connection offer.
OFTEL said the re-connection offer, aimed at winning back clients, was unfairly targeted at other companies' customers and particularly those of cable franchises.
OFTEL said the provisional ban was made in early March.
"The offer involved two clear breaches of BT's licence," Don Cruickshank, Director General of Telecommunications said in a statement.

Cruickshank said the offer was priced at less than cost and BT failed to seek permission for that. In addition, it offered special discounts, primarily to former BT customers whose telephones had been disconnected for over three months.
"The offer therefore discriminated between one class of customer and another...It was also very different from the campaign BT had described to us as targeted at people without a telephone," he said.
